notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with at least one +1/+1 counter.
description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing a creature with at least one +1/+1 counter, Carrion Feeder gets +1/+1 until end of turn.
Basri's Lieutenant trigger, creating a 2/2 Knight token.
When Knight token enters the battlefield, Grumgully triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Knight token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability by dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.
